closed_findings.closure: Menu Watch creation and removal have separate least-authority policies, exact POST and DELETE routes, distinct effects and terminal confirmation, and exhaustive active-command/network-route equality tests.

Committed, cancelled, and declined scenarios are separate and identity-bound; legal transitions, terminal receipt exclusivity, and uncertain-outcome reconciliation are frozen by schema, fixtures, and negative tests.

Proposal, commit, and cancel use distinct request identities within an account/session/method/canonical-path namespace; ambiguous paths fail closed, equivalent replay returns the original result, and changed content conflicts.
